en: A sepia-toned photograph showing a historical European street lined with 2-3 story buildings, some with signs visible. The architecture features gabled roofs and traditional facades. There are a few pedestrians, and some signs are legible, such as 'Stadt-Apotheke'. The street is relatively empty, curving slightly, leading to a prominent building in the far background. At the top, clear text reads 'Oederan i. Sa. — Freiberger Straße'.
